turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What's a key change? My friend says the last chorus of every pop song has one.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's when a song shifts to a new key, usually higher, often for the final chorus. It gives a lift, like the song is going up a gear.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is that why I get goosebumps at the end of some songs?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Quite possibly. A key change paired with a big drum fill is basically designed for goosebumps.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: a cheap trick or a real skill?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A bit of both. Some songs use it very obviously, some are subtle. Done well, it just feels exciting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Now I'm going to notice it everywhere.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You will. It's a fun game, listen for the moment where everything suddenly sounds brighter.
